C0166.title: Global Largest Game Cheat Case Cracked: Amount Involved Reaches Hundreds of Millions of Yuan
C0166.summary: In 2021, Kunshan police cracked the world's largest game cheat case, involving hundreds of millions of yuan. The cheat, known as 'Chicken Leg', provided features such as auto-aim and wallhacks, severely disrupting game balance.
